title.en: An Act to Provide for a Life Pension for Dona Aurora Aragon De Quezon, Widow of the Late President Manuel L. Quezon.

text.en:
Dona Aurora Aragon de Quezon, widow of the late President, is hereby granted a life pension of
twelve thousand pesos per annum, payable in equal monthly installment, effective upon her arrival in the
Philippines from the United States.

The sum necessary to pay said pension during the fiscal year nineteen hundred and forty six is
hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Philippine Treasury not otherwise appropriated. Thereafter, the
sum necessary shall be included in the General Appropriation Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, October 15, 1945.
